hero.speaker: Jesús
lines: New portfolio, same guy. I'm Jesús, frontend engineer: Vue and Nuxt at home, Next when the job asks for it.
35 km a week with headphones on. Rock, metal, punk, rap. Whatever makes the last kilometre shorter.
Raised on GTA. Still pull over for a Witcher sunset. And yes, F1 is a sport about milliseconds.
Nights run on CachyOS and Hyprland. The dotfiles are on GitHub, sins included. Now let me show you the city.

teaser.heading: The city is still loading
teaser.body: Phase 2 turns each of my GitHub projects into a neon district you can fly into.
